The rubric doesn't require the reviewer to specify the structure or content of the answer; it requires the authors to know what to do and how. Knowing "explain why we chose decoder-only transformers" is knowing exactly what to do. The rationale imposes extra criteria (specifying what aspects to compare, etc.) that aren't in the rubric — rubric_misapplication.
